_note: Candidate registry for Alabama 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Alabama Secretary of State, 2026 Election Information, General Election November 3, 2026: State Certification of Democratic Party Candidates, State Certification of Republican Party Candidates and State Certification of Independent Candidate (all certified by State August 26, 2026), plus the Republican Party Amended Certification of Candidates accepted September 2, 2026, linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Alabama Secretary of State, 2026 Election Information, General Election November 3, 2026: State Certification of Democratic Party Candidates, State Certification of Republican Party Candidates and State Certification of Independent Candidate (all certified by State August 26, 2026), plus the Republican Party Amended Certification of Candidates accepted September 2, 2026 (https://www.sos.alabama.gov/alabama-votes/voter/election-information/2026); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
